properties.name: reflow2's own design will move onto flo2.io, with a copy committed per PR for CI, so the dev_reflow2 family sits on one host
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-09, dev_reflow2 hub, asked how this hub should eventually watch its members (a design on flo2.io cannot watch another), chose "Move reflow2's design onto flo2.io too" over waiting for in-host reads with reflow2 left local, and over moving the hub back to local.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Settles dec:idea-reflow2s-own-design-moves-onto-flo2-io-or-stays-local as option (c1). The move itself is planned work: a copy script for reflow2's item layout, the cut's re-export, local fallbacks for the unserved tools, and a backup that keeps the design reachable if an engine release breaks opening it.
